title: Wikidata
notes: Player identity (wikidata_id), date and place of birth, and the link to each player's photo; bio_source_url links each player's entry. Last used for the 2026-07-12 enrichment. Licence: CC0.

title: Wikimedia Commons
notes: Player photos, found through each player's Wikidata entry. Each file's author, licence and page are in the players sheet (image_author, image_license, image_source_url).

title: GeoNames geographical database
notes: Club city coordinates (city_lat, city_lon). Each club's city_source_url links its GeoNames record. Licence: CC BY 4.0.
